summary: Important: vim security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
Vim (Vi IMproved) is an updated and improved version of the vi editor.

Security Fix(es):

* vim: Vimscript injection via unescaped filename in netrw s:NetrwMarkFile() filter() expression allows arbitrary code execution (CVE-2026-43961)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* vim writes file in place even though creating a backup is possible [rhel-8.10.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-282852)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
